annotations.title: Building Regulations: notifiable, which route, which Parts?

description: For one or more kinds of building work in England or Wales: is it notifiable building work, exempt (small outbuildings, ground level conservatories and porches up to 30 m2), self-certifiable by a competent person scheme (FENSA, Certass, HETAS, OFTEC, CompetentRoofer), or must it go to the Building Safety Regulator (higher-risk buildings, England). Says whether a building notice is allowed or full plans are required (non-domestic, common parts of flats, within 3 m of a public sewer), and lists the Parts of Schedule 1 likely to apply with the reason for each (indicative). Returns `verdict`, `notifiable`, per-work reasons, routes, `parts_likely_to_apply`, `must_confirm` and sources. Example: {"work":["single_storey_extension","remove_load_bearing_wall"],"within_3m_of_public_sewer":false}.

area_renovated_percent.description: Re-roofing, re-rendering, wall insulation: share of that roof or wall area being renovated, %.

competent_person_scheme.description: If the installer is a member of one (for windows, stoves, roofs).

distance_to_boundary_m.description: Outbuildings of 15 to 30 m2: distance to the nearest boundary.

floor_area_m2.description: Outbuildings, conservatories and porches: internal floor area.

heated_from_house_system.description: Conservatories: heated by extending the house heating?

higher_risk_building.description: England: at least 18 m or 7 storeys with at least 2 homes (or a care home or hospital of that height).

mainly_non_combustible.description: Outbuildings of 15 to 30 m2: built mainly of non-combustible materials?

nation.description: Defaults to england. Scotland and Northern Ireland return not_covered.

separated_by_external_doors.description: Conservatories and porches: separated from the house by external quality walls, doors or windows?

sleeping_accommodation.description: Outbuildings: will anyone sleep in it?

trade.description: Optional. The builder's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill the contractor details in notices and CDM answers and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Site Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Oakline Building Services".

licence_body.description: Trade body or competent person scheme the business is a member of (the one used for the reference).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.

work.description: All the kinds of work in the job.
